about.title: About
about.description: I started teaching myself to code at 12. Since then, I have built a perspective that connects code, people, and outcomes: understand the problem before choosing the technology, work closely with the team, and turn complexity into interfaces that feel simple. Today I work mainly with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: A path across product, frontend, backend, and infrastructure.

1.description: Technical Lead working on B2B platforms and high-scale systems with Angular, C#, and .NET. Responsible for systems architecture, technical team leadership, and roadmap management, balancing strategic vision with hands-on engineering. I define technical standards, review architecture, and make decisions that ensure scalability, quality, and continuous product evolution, with a focus on delivering robust solutions and developing the team alongside the product.

2.description: Building and evolving interfaces with React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies in direct contact with product needs.

3.description: Network infrastructure management and computer systems maintenance.

4.description: APIs and backend services for clients across different industries using Node.js and relational databases.
